title: Wealth inequality and utility: Effect evaluation of redistribution and consumption morals using the macro-econophysical coupled approach
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates 'consumption morals' and 'redistribution morals' as key parameters in its macroeconomic model. It evaluates the impact of these moral thresholds on wealth inequality and utility, drawing direct inspiration and definitions from religious traditions (such as the Quran, Buddhism, and the Bible) and philosophical frameworks regarding ethics and social responsibility.
